PRASHANT INGALE

Senior Product Owner | Agile Product Delivery | SaaS Platforms | Product Strategy | Stakeholder Management | Cross-Functional Leadership | Payments & Digital Transformation

Pune, India  |  +91-9766264548  |  prashantingale2801@gmail.com  |  LinkedIn Profile

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Product Owner with 13+ years of experience driving product vision, roadmap strategy, and Agile delivery across SaaS, digital, and enterprise platforms. Proven track record of partnering with stakeholders, customers, and engineering teams to prioritize high-value opportunities, align product development with strategic goals, and deliver customer-centric solutions. Skilled in backlog management, product lifecycle ownership, release planning, business value assessment, and leading cross-functional teams to deliver measurable business outcomes.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Product Strategy • Product Ownership • Roadmaps • Business Value • Product Development • Acquiring • Value Assessment • Transaction Banking • Cross-Functional Teams • Customer Interaction • Card Payments • Payment APIs • REST APIs • JSON • API Validation • Postman • Webhooks • Microservices • Event-Driven Architecture • Agile Scrum • SAFe • Backlog Management • Sprint Planning • Functional Analysis • BRD • FRD • User Stories • Gherkin Acceptance Criteria • AS-IS / TO-BE Analysis • Merchant Journeys • UAT • PCI-DSS • Tokenization • Mastercard

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Product Owner | ParentPay Group – SIMS Next Gen	Pune, India |June 2025 –Jan 2026

Product Area: Admissions & Pupil Management Platform (Multi-tenant SaaS Platform)

Owned product vision, roadmap planning, backlog management, and delivery for cloud-based admissions and pupil management SaaS products.

Collaborated with customers, stakeholders, engineering teams, architects, QA, and business leaders to define product requirements and align product capabilities with strategic business objectives.

Led Agile Scrum ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and release planning activities.

Defined product features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and business rules to ensure clear understanding across development teams.

Prioritized product backlog based on business value, customer outcomes, strategic priorities, and delivery feasibility.

Worked closely with business stakeholders to identify product growth opportunities and improve customer experience.

Managed dependencies, delivery risks, and roadmap alignment across multiple product initiatives.

Lead Product Manager | Mastercard (via Optimum Info System)	Pune, India | Nov 2023 – May 2025

Product Area: Settlement Platforms & Market Readiness

Led product initiatives supporting enterprise-scale payment processing, settlement, reconciliation, and cross-border payment platforms, including SEPA and Real-Time Payments (RTP) ecosystems.

Defined payment capabilities supporting transaction lifecycle management including payment initiation, validation, routing, processing, settlement, exception handling, reporting, and operational monitoring.

Partnered with engineering, architecture, operations, compliance, and business stakeholders to define requirements and deliver payment platform enhancements aligned with global payment network standards.

Contributed to payment modernization and migration programs supporting ISO 20022, CBPR+, SWIFT MT-to-MX transformation, and payment interoperability initiatives.

Worked across payment processing workflows involving payment status reporting, investigations, reconciliation, customer impact assessment, and payment traceability.

Supported operational excellence through exception management, payment repair workflows, reconciliation controls, and payment lifecycle optimization initiatives.

Collaborated with Agile delivery teams to refine user stories, prioritize backlogs, and support release planning.



Product Owner | HDFC Bank						Pune, India | Aug 2022 –July 2023

Product Area: Digital Payments & Customer Transaction Platforms

Managed payment platform enhancements supporting UPI, IMPS, AEPS, Aadhaar-enabled payments, and ACH processing within the NPCI ecosystem.

Managed end-to-end payment lifecycle including payment initiation, validation, authorization, transaction routing, settlement, reconciliation, reversals, and exception handling.

Defined product requirements, business rules, and operational workflows supporting high-volume payment processing platforms.

Collaborated with engineering and architecture teams to enhance payment APIs, transaction orchestration services, and integration capabilities across internal and external payment ecosystems.

Worked closely with operations teams to investigate payment failures, authorization issues, transaction exceptions, and settlement discrepancies, ensuring timely resolution and customer impact mitigation.

Supported payment status tracking, retry mechanisms, transaction recovery processes, and operational resilience initiatives to improve payment success rates.

Partnered with risk, compliance, and business stakeholders to ensure payment processing controls aligned with regulatory and operational requirements.

Contributed to ISO 20022 transformation initiatives and modernization of payment messaging and transaction processing capabilities.

Product Owner | RBL Bank			      		       Pune, India | Apr 2016 – Aug 2022

Product Area: Mobile Banking & AEPS Platforms

Managed payment platform enhancements supporting UPI, IMPS, AEPS, Aadhaar-enabled payments, and ACH processing within the NPCI ecosystem.

Defined functional requirements and business workflows supporting transaction authorization, routing, processing, settlement, reconciliation, and exception management.

Worked closely with NPCI interfaces, sponsor banks, and technology teams to support reliable transaction processing and payment lifecycle management.

Collaborated with API and integration teams to deliver payment services supporting real-time transaction processing and asynchronous event-driven workflows.

Participated in payment platform modernization initiatives focused on scalability, operational resilience, transaction visibility, and processing efficiency.

Supported transaction monitoring, payment investigations, dispute management, settlement validation, and operational governance processes.

Contributed to payment workflow orchestration initiatives supporting multiple payment rails and customer payment journeys.

Product Owner | RBL Bank	   Pune, India | Sep 2013 –Apr 2016

Product Area: Loan Origination System (LOS)

Managed end-to-end business analysis for Loan Origination System covering application capture, KYC & eligibility checks, credit assessment inputs, approval workflows, and loan disbursement.

Conducted 50+ requirement gathering sessions with business stakeholders; authored Functional Specification Documents (FSDs) adopted as the baseline for all LOS development work.

Designed UAT test scenarios and business validation cases for 8 major LOS releases, achieving 95%+ first-pass acceptance across all releases.

Bridged gap between business and technology teams, reducing requirement ambiguity and contributing to a 20% reduction in post-go-live defects over 3 years.

EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS

MBA | North Maharashtra University

Certifications: SAFe POPM | CSPO (Certified Scrum Product Owner) | CSM (Certified Scrum Master) | Certified Business Analyst

Tools & Platforms: JIRA | Confluence | Azure DevOps | Miro | Figma | Swagger | Lucid | MS Office Suite
